hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Central Europe, between Austria and Switzerland || mostly mountainous (Alps) with Rhine Valley in western third || along with Uzbekistan, one of only two doubly landlocked countries in the world; variety of microclimatic variations based on elevation || Resources: hydroelectric potential, arable land || Exports: small specialty machinery, connectors for audio and video, parts for motor vehicles, dental products, hardware

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly mountainous (Alps) with Rhine Valley in western third || Central Europe, between Austria and Switzerland

climate.excerpt: continental; cold, cloudy winters with frequent snow or rain; cool to moderately warm, cloudy, humid summers || avalanches, landslides

economy.excerpt: high-income European economy; Schengen Area participant; key European financial leader; integrated with Swiss economy and franc currency user; one of the highest GDP per capita countries; relies on US and Eurozone markets for exports || Exports: small specialty machinery, connectors for audio and video, parts for motor vehicles, dental products, hardware || Industries: electronics, metal manufacturing, dental products, ceramics, pharmaceuticals, food products, precision instruments, tourism, optical instruments
